query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN gbif_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_gbif_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN conservation_status IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_iucn_status
FROM plants;
